more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Dichlorodifluoromethane is a defined fluorinated compound listed by FDA as a direct-contact food-freezing agent. The regulation requires a minimum purity of 99.97% and food-grade identification. Its technological purpose is rapid cooling during manufacture. This application is distinct from adding a sweetener, colour or nutrient to the finished food.
more_info.uses: Used as a direct-contact freezing agent during food manufacture. The US regulation requires food-grade material and prescribed purity. It does not identify a particular retail-food category as the sole application.
